page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. The server utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture and is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 1.85 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local NVMe SSD storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge offers a dense allocation of dedicated compute resources relative to its memory footprint, making it a viable option for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory capacities. It is well-suited for parallel processing tasks, high-performance computing, batch processing, and compute-heavy web serving applications.
